# UI Fidelity Checklist: Rediseño de Autenticación (Stitch)

**Purpose**: Sanity check para el desarrollador enfocado en la completitud de la fidelidad visual (colores, fondos y contenedores) dentro de la especificación.
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Completitud de Requisitos Visuales (Colores y Fondos)

- [x] CHK001 Are the global background color (`#0d1021`) and radial gradients explicitly documented for the auth layout? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the specific Tailwind variable names (e.g., `--primary`, `--background`) mapped to the Stitch color palette in the requirements? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK003 Are the start and end colors for the primary button gradients clearly specified? [Completeness, Quickstart]

## Definición de Contenedores y Estilos

- [x] CHK004 Is the `.glass-panel` style explicitly defined with its specific `backdrop-blur` and background opacity values? [Clarity, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK005 Are the hover and active states for `.glass-panel` components (e.g., `.card-hover`) documented in the requirements? [Coverage, Edge Case]

## Consistencia de Fuentes

- [x] CHK006 Does the spec clearly state that the application's existing typography must be inherited and NOT overridden? [Consistency, Plan §Summary]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
